t: Hi, everyone. My name is Marta Reyes. I am from Valparaiso, in Chile. I am a teacher, and I also work with teacher training in twelve schools. This year we are working with digital tools in the classroom. It is my first time in this group.

Good morning. I am Paulo Cardoso, from Porto, in Portugal. I am a coordinator in a public school with nine hundred students. My work is mostly with families and with data protection. I am very happy to be here.
